```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
```

Follows `mcda/MCDA_paper_results_spec.md`. Instruction: `mcda/instructions/2026_11_25_budget_allocation_style.md`.

Malta respondents allocated 1,000 euros across 10 criteria; Klagenfurt respondents 1,000,000 euros across 6.
Weights are percentage shares (spec 2.2), so the scale does not matter for the weights, but the budget size
may change how people allocate. Budget and city are confounded (each city had one budget and its own set of
criteria), so everything here is descriptive: a difference between the cities cannot be attributed to the budget.

- **Part 0.** How allocations could be entered, read from the raw data.
- **Part A.** Allocation style per respondent, summarised per city.
- **Part B.** Sensitivity: median instead of mean weights. This notebook writes the Table S6 rows to
  `data/citydata_outputs/median_weights_sensitivity.rds`; `Tables_MCDA.Rmd` adds them to Table S6. No score file is changed.

```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
source(here::here("R/read_survey.R"))
source(here::here("R/theme_lancet.R"))

OUT <- here::here("output/figures_mcda/survey_allocation_style_2026_11_25")
dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
city_cols <- c(Malta = "#2166ac", Klagenfurt = "#b2182b")
city_lev  <- c("Klagenfurt", "Malta")   # panel order: Klagenfurt above, Malta below

knitting <- function() isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))
ktab <- function(x, caption, digits = 1) {
  x <- x %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(., digits)))
  if (!knitting()) {
    cat("\n", caption, "\n", sep = "")
    print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE)
    return(invisible(x))
  }
  x %>% kable(caption = caption) %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
}
fmt_p  <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.2f", p))   # spec 7.1
fmt_pc <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", x)
fmt_r  <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)
save_fig <- function(p, name, h) {
  ggsave(file.path(OUT, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = 180, height = h, units = "mm",
         device = ragg::agg_png, res = 300, bg = "white")
  save_figure_pptx(p, name, OUT, height_mm = h, width_mm = 180)
  invisible(file.path(OUT, paste0(name, c(".png", ".pptx"))))
}
```

# Respondents

Same respondents as the weights in the scoring notebooks: Malta all responses; Klagenfurt current residents
only (former residents, `resident == "left-2-plus"`, excluded; spec 2.1). In Klagenfurt a blank allocation is
read as 0, as in `Klagenfurt_MCDA_260520.Rmd`.

```{r survey}
m_raw <- read_survey(here::here("data/malta/maltasurvey_jun26.xlsx"))
k_raw <- read_survey(here::here("data/klagenfurt/klagenfurtsurvey_nov26.xlsx"), dot_names = TRUE)

m_cols <- c(`Lack-recreational-facilities` = "Recreation", overcrowding = "Green per person",
            `poor-accessibility` = "Green proximity", `lack-blue-spaces` = "Blue space",
            `poor-airquality` = "Air quality", `noise-pollution` = "Noise", `urban-heat` = "Urban heat",
            `lack-street-greenery` = "Street greenery", `grey-infrastracture` = "Grey infrastructure",
            `traffic-dominance` = "Traffic")
k_cols <- c(alloc_1_TooHotStreets = "Urban heat", alloc_2_GreenOutOfReach = "Green proximity",
            alloc_3_LowIncomeNeighborhoods = "Low income", alloc_4_HighTrafficAreas = "Traffic",
            alloc_5_PoorAirQuality = "Air quality", alloc_6_DisconnectedNatureWater = "Blue space")

k_blank <- sum(is.na(k_raw %>% filter(resident != "left-2-plus") %>% select(all_of(names(k_cols)))))
k_sv <- k_raw %>% filter(resident != "left-2-plus") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(names(k_cols)), ~ replace_na(., 0)))

budget <- c(Malta = 1000, Klagenfurt = 1e6)
long <- bind_rows(
  m_raw %>% mutate(resp = row_number()) %>% select(resp, all_of(names(m_cols))) %>%
    pivot_longer(-resp, names_to = "item", values_to = "amount") %>%
    mutate(city = "Malta", criterion = unname(m_cols[item])),
  k_sv %>% mutate(resp = row_number()) %>% select(resp, all_of(names(k_cols))) %>%
    pivot_longer(-resp, names_to = "item", values_to = "amount") %>%
    mutate(city = "Klagenfurt", criterion = unname(k_cols[item]))) %>%
  mutate(budget = budget[city], share = 100 * amount / budget)

n_resp <- long %>% distinct(city, resp) %>% count(city, name = "respondents")
ktab(n_resp %>% mutate(responses_in_file = c(Klagenfurt = nrow(k_raw), Malta = nrow(m_raw))[city],
                       blank_allocations_read_as_0 = c(Klagenfurt = k_blank, Malta = 0)[city]),
     "Respondents used (same as the weights)")
```

# Part 0. Survey interface

Survey instrument: the web survey code in `GreenSpace/Codes/MCDA_MM/city_surveys/` (outside this repository;
Malta `malta-survey/script1.js`, last commit 2026-03-20; Klagenfurt `klagenfurt-survey/script.js`, last commit
2026-04-10), checked 26 November 2026. In both cities each criterion has one slider (`<input type="range">`)
that starts at 0: Malta `min = 0, max = 500, step = 20` euros; Klagenfurt `max = 500,000, step = 20,000` euros
(`CRITERION_MAX`, `CRITERION_STEP`), that is steps of 2% of the budget and at most 50% per criterion in both.
A slider cannot exceed the remaining budget (a move beyond it is capped at the remaining amount, with a
warning), and the preview button, which leads to submission, stays disabled until the total equals the budget
exactly (`btnPreview.disabled = (total !== TOTAL_BUDGET)`), so the full budget had to be allocated. The table
below checks this against the raw allocation values.

```{r part0}
grid_tab <- long %>% group_by(city) %>% summarise(
  respondents = n_distinct(resp),
  criteria = n_distinct(criterion),
  budget_eur = first(budget),
  distinct_allocation_values = n_distinct(amount),
  smallest_nonzero_eur = min(amount[amount > 0]),
  smallest_nonzero_pct = min(share[share > 0]),
  largest_eur = max(amount),
  largest_pct = max(share),
  all_on_2pct_grid = all(abs(share / 2 - round(share / 2)) < 1e-9),
  non_integer_eur = sum(amount %% 1 != 0),
  .groups = "drop")
totals <- long %>% group_by(city, resp) %>% summarise(total = sum(amount), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(city) %>% summarise(respondents_not_full_budget = sum(abs(total - budget[first(city)]) > 1e-6),
                               min_total = min(total), max_total = max(total), .groups = "drop")
part0 <- grid_tab %>% left_join(totals, by = "city")
ktab(part0, "Part 0. Allocation values in the raw data")
```

**Reading.** In both cities every allocation is a multiple of 2% of the budget (20 euros in Malta,
20,000 euros in Klagenfurt), no allocation exceeds 50% of the budget, and every respondent's allocations sum
exactly to the budget, as the survey code requires. Because every slider starts at 0, a criterion the
respondent did not move is recorded as 0, so a 0 can mean "no priority" or "not touched"; the data cannot
separate the two. Consequence for Part A: on a 2% grid the only multiples of 5% of
the budget are the multiples of 10%, so the two heaping measures coincide; and in Klagenfurt the exactly
equal split (16.7%) is not on the grid, so no respondent could allocate exactly equal amounts.

```{r part0-values}
val_tab <- long %>% count(city, share, name = "allocations") %>% group_by(city) %>%
  mutate(pct_of_allocations = 100 * allocations / sum(allocations), multiple_of_10pct = abs(share %% 10) < 1e-9) %>%
  ungroup()
ktab(val_tab %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = share, names_from = city, values_from = pct_of_allocations, values_fill = 0) %>%
       arrange(share) %>% rename(`Allocation (% of budget)` = share),
     "Distribution of allocation values (% of all allocations, per city)")
```

```{r fig-values, fig.width=180/25.4, fig.height=110/25.4}
p_val <- val_tab %>% mutate(city = factor(city, city_lev),
                            heap = ifelse(multiple_of_10pct, "Multiple of 10% of the budget", "Other value")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(share, pct_of_allocations, fill = city, alpha = heap)) +
  geom_col(width = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ city, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = city_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Multiple of 10% of the budget" = 1, "Other value" = 0.45), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(-1.5, 51.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "Allocation to one criterion (% of the budget)", y = "Share of all allocations (%)") +
  theme_lancet() + theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 3, 3), legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left")
p_val
save_fig(p_val, "A_allocation_values", 110)
```

# Part A. Allocation style

Per respondent: number of criteria given 0; highest share; share of non zero allocations that are multiples
of 10% and of 5% of the budget; normalised entropy H = -sum(p log p) / log(number of criteria) (0 log 0 = 0;
1 = perfectly even, 0 = everything to one criterion); exactly equal amounts to all criteria; and, because the
exact equal split is not on the Klagenfurt grid, "as even as the grid allows" = highest minus lowest share at
most one step (2 percentage points), which in Malta is the same as exactly equal (the shares must sum to 100%).
Chance level for heaping: on the 2% grid from 2% to 50%, 5 of the 25 non zero values (20%) are multiples of 10%.

```{r part-a}
resp <- long %>% group_by(city, resp) %>% summarise(
  k = n(),
  n_zero = sum(amount == 0),
  any_zero = n_zero > 0,
  max_share = max(share),
  nonzero = sum(amount > 0),
  mult10 = sum(amount > 0 & abs(share %% 10) < 1e-9),
  mult5  = sum(amount > 0 & abs(share %% 5) < 1e-9),
  entropy = { p <- share[share > 0] / 100; -sum(p * log(p)) / log(n()) },
  exactly_equal = n_distinct(amount) == 1,
  as_even_as_grid = max(share) - min(share) <= 2 + 1e-9,
  .groups = "drop")

q3 <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f (%.1f to %.1f)", median(x), quantile(x, 0.25), quantile(x, 0.75))
q3r <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f (%.3f to %.3f)", median(x), quantile(x, 0.25), quantile(x, 0.75))
A_tab <- resp %>% group_by(city) %>% summarise(
  respondents = n(),
  `Gave 0 to at least one criterion (%)` = fmt_pc(100 * mean(any_zero)),
  `Criteria with 0, median (IQR)` = q3(n_zero),
  `Highest share to one criterion (%), median (IQR)` = q3(max_share),
  `Non zero allocations that are multiples of 10% of the budget (%)` = fmt_pc(100 * sum(mult10) / sum(nonzero)),
  `Non zero allocations that are multiples of 5% of the budget (%)` = fmt_pc(100 * sum(mult5) / sum(nonzero)),
  `Normalised entropy, median (IQR)` = q3r(entropy),
  `Exactly equal amounts to all criteria (%)` = fmt_pc(100 * mean(exactly_equal)),
  `As even as the grid allows (%)` = fmt_pc(100 * mean(as_even_as_grid)),
  .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(city = factor(city, c("Malta", "Klagenfurt"))) %>% arrange(city)
A_long <- A_tab %>% mutate(respondents = as.character(respondents)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-city, names_to = "Measure") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = city, values_from = value)
ktab(A_long, "Part A. Allocation style per city")

mw <- function(v) { t <- wilcox.test(resp[[v]][resp$city == "Malta"], resp[[v]][resp$city == "Klagenfurt"], exact = FALSE)
  tibble(measure = v, malta_median = median(resp[[v]][resp$city == "Malta"]),
         klagenfurt_median = median(resp[[v]][resp$city == "Klagenfurt"]), W = unname(t$statistic), p = fmt_p(t$p.value)) }
A_test <- bind_rows(mw("max_share"), mw("entropy")) %>%
  mutate(measure = c(max_share = "Highest share (%)", entropy = "Normalised entropy")[measure])
ktab(A_test, "Part A. Mann-Whitney test, Malta vs Klagenfurt (descriptive only: budget and city are confounded)", 3)
```

```{r fig-a, fig.width=180/25.4, fig.height=110/25.4}
hist_city <- function(v, binwidth, xlab, fmt, boundary = 0) {
  dd  <- resp %>% mutate(city = factor(city, city_lev))
  med <- dd %>% group_by(city) %>% summarise(m = median(.data[[v]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(lab = paste0("Median ", fmt(m)))
  ggplot(dd, aes(.data[[v]], fill = city)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = binwidth, boundary = boundary, colour = NA) +
    geom_vline(data = med, aes(xintercept = m), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_label(data = med, aes(m, Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.3,
               size = pt_size(7), family = lancet_font, fill = "white", label.size = 0,
               label.padding = unit(0.5, "mm")) +
    facet_wrap(~ city, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = city_cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Number of respondents") +
    theme_lancet() + theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 3, 3))
}
# Highest share: bins centred on the 2% grid
p_max <- hist_city("max_share", 2, "Highest share given to a single criterion (% of the budget)",
                   function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), boundary = 1)
p_ent <- hist_city("entropy", 0.02, "Normalised entropy of the respondent's shares (1 = perfectly even)",
                   function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x))
p_max
p_ent
save_fig(p_max, "A_highest_share_hist", 110)
save_fig(p_ent, "A_entropy_hist", 110)
```

# Part B. Median instead of mean weights

Main weights (spec 2.2): mean percentage share per criterion. Sensitivity: median percentage share per
criterion, rescaled to sum to 100%. Klagenfurt air quality is one criterion; its weight is split equally
between NO2 and PM2.5, as in the main score (spec 3.2). The score is recomputed with the available weight rule
(spec 4.2) on the cells scored in the main score, from the saved normalised criteria, and compared with the
main citizen score (spec 5.1, 5.2).

```{r part-b-weights}
W <- long %>% group_by(city, criterion) %>%
  summarise(mean_share = mean(share), median_share = median(share), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(city) %>%
  mutate(mean_weight_pct = 100 * mean_share / sum(mean_share),
         median_weight_pct = 100 * median_share / sum(median_share),
         difference_pp = median_weight_pct - mean_weight_pct) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(city = factor(city, c("Malta", "Klagenfurt"))) %>% arrange(city, desc(mean_weight_pct))
ktab(W, "Part B. Mean and median shares per criterion, and the weights they give (%)")
```

```{r fig-b-weights, fig.width=180/25.4, fig.height=100/25.4}
p_w <- W %>% mutate(city = factor(city, city_lev)) %>%
  select(city, criterion, Mean = mean_weight_pct, Median = median_weight_pct) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Mean, Median), names_to = "weights", values_to = "w") %>%
  # order criteria by mean weight within each city (suffix keeps the orders separate per facet)
  mutate(criterion = reorder(paste(criterion, city, sep = "___"), ifelse(weights == "Mean", w, 0), sum)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(w, criterion, shape = weights, colour = city)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = criterion), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ city, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("___.*$", "", x)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = city_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Mean = 16, Median = 1), name = "Weights") +
  labs(x = "Weight (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_lancet() + theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 3, 3), legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left")
p_w
save_fig(p_w, "B_mean_vs_median_weights", 100)
```

```{r part-b-score}
malta <- readRDS(here::here("data/malta/malta_mcda_processed_realloc.rds")) %>% st_drop_geometry()
klag  <- readRDS(here::here("data/klagenfurt/klagenfurt_mcda_priority_may.rds")) %>% st_drop_geometry()
stopifnot(nrow(malta) == 10657, n_distinct(malta$gid) == 10657, nrow(klag) == 12418, n_distinct(klag$ID) == 12418)
score_files <- here::here(c("data/malta/malta_mcda_processed_realloc.rds", "data/klagenfurt/klagenfurt_mcda_priority_may.rds"))
ktab(tibble(file = sub(paste0(here::here(), "/"), "", score_files), md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(score_files)),
            modified = format(file.mtime(score_files), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")), "Score files read (not changed)")

# Criterion to indicator
m_map <- c(Recreation = "norm_dist_rec", `Green per person` = "norm_green_exp", `Green proximity` = "norm_green_time",
           `Blue space` = "norm_dist_bs", `Air quality` = "norm_no2", Noise = "norm_Lden", `Urban heat` = "norm_lst",
           `Street greenery` = "norm_tree", `Grey infrastructure` = "norm_imd", Traffic = "norm_traffic")
k_map <- list(`Urban heat` = "norm_lst", `Green proximity` = "norm_green_time", `Low income` = "norm_income_weighted",
              Traffic = "norm_traffic_cat", `Air quality` = c("norm_no2", "norm_pm25"), `Blue space` = "norm_dist_bs")
ind_w <- function(cn, col) {
  w <- W %>% filter(city == cn) %>% select(criterion, w = all_of(col)) %>% tibble::deframe()
  mp <- if (cn == "Malta") as.list(m_map) else k_map
  unlist(lapply(names(mp), function(cr) setNames(rep(w[[cr]] / length(mp[[cr]]), length(mp[[cr]])), mp[[cr]]))) / 100
}
wlc <- function(d, w, keep) {
  S <- as.matrix(d[, names(w)]); A <- !is.na(S); S[!A] <- 0
  den <- as.numeric(A %*% w); out <- as.numeric(S %*% w) / den
  out[!keep | den == 0] <- NA
  out
}
sens_cmp <- function(x, ref) {
  ok <- !is.na(ref) & !is.na(x)
  q_r <- ntile(ref[ok], 5); q_x <- ntile(x[ok], 5)
  list(spearman = cor(ref[ok], x[ok], method = "spearman"),
       top_quintile_retained_pct = 100 * mean(q_x[q_r == 5] == 5),
       cells_changing_quintile_pct = 100 * mean(q_x != q_r), cells = sum(ok),
       q_r = q_r, q_x = q_x)
}
B <- list(); B_rows <- list()
for (cn in c("Malta", "Klagenfurt")) {
  d <- if (cn == "Malta") malta else klag
  keep <- !is.na(d$priority_citizen)
  w_mean <- ind_w(cn, "mean_weight_pct"); w_med <- ind_w(cn, "median_weight_pct")
  s_mean <- wlc(d, w_mean, keep); s_med <- wlc(d, w_med, keep)
  # Check: the mean weights reproduce the saved citizen score
  chk <- max(abs(s_mean - d$priority_citizen), na.rm = TRUE)
  stopifnot(chk < 1e-8, identical(is.na(s_mean), is.na(d$priority_citizen)))
  r <- sens_cmp(s_med, d$priority_citizen)
  B[[cn]] <- r
  B_rows[[cn]] <- tibble(city = cn, scored_cells = sum(keep), cells_compared = r$cells,
                         cells_not_scored_median = sum(keep & is.na(s_med)),
                         max_abs_diff_mean_vs_saved = chk, spearman = r$spearman,
                         top_quintile_overlap_pct = r$top_quintile_retained_pct,
                         cells_changing_quintile_pct = r$cells_changing_quintile_pct,
                         cells_changing_2plus_quintiles = sum(abs(r$q_x - r$q_r) >= 2))
}
B_tab <- bind_rows(B_rows)
ktab(B_tab, "Part B. Median weights score vs main citizen score (same cells)", 3)

# Table S6 rows, same format as the scoring notebooks
s6_median <- B_tab %>% transmute(city, test_name = "Weights: median instead of mean", spearman_r = fmt_r(spearman),
                                 class_agreement = fmt_pc(top_quintile_overlap_pct),
                                 cells_changing_quintile = fmt_pc(cells_changing_quintile_pct))
saveRDS(s6_median, here::here("data/citydata_outputs/median_weights_sensitivity.rds"))
ktab(s6_median, "Rows added to Table S6")
```

```{r fig-b-score, fig.width=180/25.4, fig.height=85/25.4}
trans <- bind_rows(lapply(names(B), function(cn) tibble(city = cn, main = B[[cn]]$q_r, median = B[[cn]]$q_x))) %>%
  count(city, main, median) %>% group_by(city, main) %>% mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(city = factor(city, city_lev))
p_tr <- ggplot(trans, aes(factor(median), factor(main), fill = pct)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", pct), colour = pct > 50), size = pt_size(7), family = lancet_font) +
  facet_wrap(~ city, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "grey25", limits = c(0, 100), name = "% of the main\nquintile's cells") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "black"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Quintile, median weights", y = "Quintile, main citizen score (mean weights)") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_lancet() + theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 3, 3), axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
p_tr
save_fig(p_tr, "B_quintile_transitions", 85)
ktab(trans %>% select(city, main, median, cells = n, pct) %>% arrange(city, main, median),
     "Part B. Quintile transitions, main score vs median weights score (% of the main quintile's cells)")
```
